First, I think about what each tool does. A balance measures weight, so that doesn't seem relevant here. A hot plate is used for heating, but I don't know if it can measure time. A thermometer measures temperature, which is important because water boils at 100°C. A stopwatch is used to measure time, so that seems relevant too.

But the thermometer is also important because we need to know when it reaches 100°C. So maybe both are involved. But the question is asking which tool would be best to use. 

I think the primary goal is to measure the time, so the stopwatch is the tool for that. The thermometer is more about the condition (temperature) rather than the duration. So the best tool here is the stopwatch.
